title: Why Printer Ink Costs More Than Champagne
topic: Why printer ink costs more than champagne
mechanism: The printer is cheap bait; the money is in ink priced above champagne, guarded by cartridge chips and drained by head cleaning.

beats.hook: You bought a brand new printer for forty-nine dollars
beats.story: It prints tickets, homework and a giant cat poster
beats.rise: What a steal; even the low-ink light is no problem
beats.twist: At the checkout the cashier scans two cartridges: sixty-eight dollars, more than the printer
beats.mechanism: Price tag $13 AN OUNCE next to a champagne bottle, ink poured into a champagne glass, cartridge chip with CHIP label, update screen REJECTED, cleaning spray, gauge ON PAPER 20-30%, TV studio with the boss
beats.ending: Back home the new cartridge already blinks LOW INK

seed.what: The small STARTER INK cartridge sticker on the printer box

locations.set: Room cold + giant cartridge and chip
Room neon + desk + ON AIR sign

gags.what: The cat poster shoots out so fast it smacks you in the face
A waiter pours ink into a champagne glass, sips it and turns blue in the mouth
The cleaning spray squirts ink all over the tester's coat
